description.narrative: Health Happens Here is more than a title—it’s a statement of intent. It signals that health isn’t just the result of medical interventions in clinics or hospitals; it begins wherever people live, learn, work and make decisions about their bodies and lives. In communities, schools, clinics, digital spaces and home - here is where rights are claimed, stigma is challenged, and access is either granted or denied. This name reflects a belief that change must be rooted in the everyday realities of young people, particularly girls and marginalised groups, and that true health equity can only be achieved by transforming the systems, norms and power dynamics that shape those realities. Whether it's a policy shift, a peer-led workshop or a quiet moment of decision-making - health happens here.
